description: KP Planet-House Combination Rules — 9 planets x 12 houses + special cases

Moon.gives: Emotional connection, public popularity, mental peace

Saturn.gives: Patience, hard work, delays, obstacles, endurance

Rahu.gives: Sudden changes, foreign connections, unconventional paths

Ketu.gives: Spiritual inclination, sudden events, detachment from material

house_domains.1: Self, personality, physical body, general vitality
house_domains.2: Wealth, family, speech, food, face, accumulated assets
house_domains.3: Courage, siblings, short journeys, communication, efforts
house_domains.4: Mother, home, property, vehicles, education, emotional peace
house_domains.6: Disease, enemies, debts, service, daily work, obstacles
house_domains.8: Longevity, inheritance, sudden gains/losses, occult, transformation

house_domains.10: Career, status, profession, government, public reputation
house_domains.11: Gains, fulfillment, friends, elder siblings, aspirations
house_domains.12: Losses, expenses, foreign lands, spirituality, hospitalization, moksha

special_cases.effect: Retrograde Saturn intensifies karmic lessons. Delays become more pronounced. Past karma from previous life must be resolved. Inner discipline is the key.
Retrograde Jupiter turns wisdom inward. External fortune may be delayed but inner wisdom grows. Spiritual growth over material gains.
Retrograde Mars turns aggression inward. Energy is internalized. Property matters face delays. Courage expressed through inner battles.
Combust Venus weakens love and luxury. Marriage matters face obstacles. Artistic talents suppressed. Relationships may lack warmth.
Combust Mercury weakens intellect and communication. Business decisions may be poor. Education faces obstacles. Ego overshadows intellect.
Exalted Sun in Aries gives maximum authority, leadership, and recognition. Government success. Father is very fortunate. Career peaks.
Exalted Moon in Taurus gives maximum emotional peace, public popularity, and wealth. Mother is very fortunate. Real estate gains.
Exalted Jupiter in Cancer gives maximum wisdom, fortune, and expansion. Children are blessed. Marriage is fortunate. Spiritual grace.
Debilitated Saturn in Aries weakens discipline and karma resolution. Delays become erratic. Hard work does not yield expected results. Patience is tested.
Debilitated Mars in Cancer weakens courage and energy. Property matters face emotional obstacles. Aggression turns inward. Surgery risks increase.

special_cases.interpretation: Planet in its own sign (e.g., Sun in Leo, Moon in Cancer) is strong and gives full results of the houses it signifies.
Planet in friend's sign is comfortable and gives good results. Sun-Moon-Mars are friends; Mercury-Venus are friends; Jupiter-Sun-Moon-Mars are friends.
Planet in enemy's sign struggles to give results. Sun-Saturn are enemies; Moon-Mercury are neutral; Mars-Mercury are enemies.
Planet in Mooltrikona (special dignity) is very strong. Sun=Leo 0-20°, Moon=Taurus 4-30°, Mars=Aries 0-12°, Mercury=Virgo 16-20°, Jupiter=Sagittarius 0-10°, Venus=Libra 0-15°, Saturn=Aquarius 0-20°.
Vargottama (same sign in D1 and D9) planet is exceptionally strong and gives consistent results throughout life.
Planet at 0° or 29° (critical degrees) is in transition and may give unpredictable results until it stabilizes.
Planet in gandanta (junction of water and fire signs: 29°20' Cancer-0°40' Leo, 29°20' Scorpio-0°40' Sagittarius, 29°20' Pisces-0°40' Aries) faces karmic challenges.
Planet in pushkara navamsa (special degrees in D9) is highly auspicious and gives exceptional results. Specific degrees vary by sign.
Planet in same sign in D1 and D9 (vargottama) is very strong and gives consistent, reliable results throughout life.
Atmakaraka (planet with highest degree) represents soul's purpose. Its house and sign show life's main karmic lessons.
Amatyakaraka (planet with second highest degree) indicates career and professional achievements in life.
Yogakaraka (planet ruling kendra and trikona) is highly beneficial. For Taurus/Libra lagna=Saturn, Cancer=Mars, Leo=Mars, Capricorn/Aquarius=Venus.
Maraka (death-inflicting) planets are lords of 2nd and 7th houses. Their dasha periods can bring health challenges or major life changes.
Badhaka (obstacle-creating) planet varies by lagna type. For movable signs=11th lord, fixed=9th lord, dual=7th lord. Brings obstacles in its dasha.
Debilitated planet with cancellation (neecha bhanga) becomes very powerful. Conditions: debilitated lord exalted, or debilitated planet aspected by its lord.
Mutual exchange of houses by two planets (parivartana) creates strong connection. Maha parivartana (kendra/trikona lords) is highly beneficial.
When two planets are within 1 degree (planetary war), the one with higher longitude wins. Winner becomes very strong, loser weakens.
